paths.react-router-dom: Import from `react-router`. Router v7 ships both, and under Vite they resolve to two modules with two React contexts — a hook taken from this one looks for a Router in a context the app never filled, and throws `useNavigate() may be used only in the context of a <Router>` at mount.

@medbrains/api.message: Import the API area you call from `@medbrains/api/modules/<area>` (e.g. `patientsApi`). `api` holds every area, so importing it puts the whole client (about 400 KB) back into this screen's download, and into first load if the shell reaches it.
